summary: This is a Makefile target definition that creates a help command. When someone runs 'make help', it will display documentation showing all available commands in this Makefile.

explanations.1: The '# highlight-next-line' comment is a special directive that tells documentation tools or editors to visually emphasize or mark the next line as important.
explanations.2: In a Makefile, 'help:' defines a target (a command you can run), and '##' followed by text is a convention where the comment becomes the help text displayed when listing available commands.
